scenes.say: Gold breaks the low? Often it's just a sweep.

scenes.text: Price dips briefly below a low, grabs the stops – and turns.
scenes.say: Liquidity sweep: grab the stops, then turn.

scenes.title: A *long wick* below the low
scenes.caption: The body closes back above it.
scenes.say: Sign one: a long wick below the low.

scenes.text: Volume spikes – stops get triggered, big orders get filled.

scenes.title: *Fast return* above the low
scenes.caption: Only then does the wick become a sweep.
scenes.say: Sign three: a fast return above the low.

scenes.text: Trading every wick as a sweep. Without a fast return, it's often a real breakout.

scenes.title: No time to analyze the market *yourself*?
scenes.say: No time to analyze it yourself?

items.text: Sweep below the low – stop placed
